! ------------ POLY2_ FUNCTION ----------- j1 = 0 ! draw contour, j2 = 1 ! draw fill, j3 = 1 ! close an open polygon, j4 = 0 ! local fill orientation, j6 = 0 ! fill is cut fill (default is drafting fill), j7 = 0 ! fill is cover fill (only if j6 = 0, default is drafting fill).
frame_fill = j1 + 2*j2 + 4*j3 + 8*j4 + 32*j6 + 64*j7
! ----------------------------- ! fill_type = 64 fill fill_type pen fill_pen POLY2_ 4, frame_fill, 0,0,1, a,0,1, a,b,1, 0,b,1 ! ----------POLY2_ FUNCTIONEND --------
return
